manifest.name: teammate-run
manifest.description: One recorded execution of one teammate assignment (backlog:8986f4459f0f): agent, assignment, cost and outcome of every run, including runs the spending cap stopped. A run that proposes actions waits for a human approval; a run that produces a versioned artifact carries it inline with its version. (backlog:8986f4459f0f)

migrations.name: create_teammate_runs
migrations.sql:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS teammate_runs (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  source_key TEXT UNIQUE,
  space_id TEXT,
  agent_source_key TEXT,
  assignment_source_key TEXT,
  started_at TEXT,
  cost_cents INTEGER,
  outcome TEXT CHECK(outcome IN ('started', 'proposed', 'applied', 'artifact', 'capped', 'failed')),
  proposals TEXT,
  artifact TEXT,
  artifact_version INTEGER,
  note TEXT,
  decided_at TEXT,
  actor_type TEXT CHECK(actor_type IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  actor_id TEXT,
  source_package TEXT,
  source_action TEXT,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
) STRICT;
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_runs_space_id ON teammate_runs(space_id);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_runs_agent_source_key ON teammate_runs(agent_source_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_runs_assignment_source_key ON teammate_runs(assignment_source_key);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS teammate_runs_source_package ON teammate_runs(source_package);

bootstrap.name: pg_bootstrap_teammate_runs
bootstrap.sql:

  "id" TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  "source_key" TEXT UNIQUE,
  "space_id" TEXT,
  "agent_source_key" TEXT,
  "assignment_source_key" TEXT,
  "started_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "cost_cents" BIGINT,
  "outcome" TEXT CHECK("outcome" IN ('started', 'proposed', 'applied', 'artifact', 'capped', 'failed')),
  "proposals" TEXT,
  "artifact" TEXT,
  "artifact_version" BIGINT,
  "note" TEXT,
  "decided_at" TIMESTAMPTZ,
  "actor_type" TEXT CHECK("actor_type" IN ('user', 'agent', 'system')),
  "actor_id" TEXT,
  "source_package" TEXT,
  "source_action" TEXT,
  "created_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL
);

CREATE INDEX "teammate_runs_space_id"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_runs"("space_id");

CREATE INDEX "teammate_runs_agent_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_runs"("agent_source_key");

CREATE INDEX "teammate_runs_assignment_source_key"
  ON "accordo"."teammate_runs"("assignment_source_key");
